name: Corner Café Unit, Lantern Row
requires_text: Mr. Okafor leases to registered companies only.
agent_line: Mr. Okafor: "Keys, meter readings, and my number. The espresso smell is included."
blurb: A small shop front on a corner that half of Old Town walks past. It comes empty: fit it out, get the food licence at City Hall, and open. The rent is due whether anyone buys a coffee or not.
